fields.label: Arm pitch (degrees)
fields.description: How open the arms are. Small = tightly wound, large = loosely wound.

fields.label: Arm width (degrees)
fields.description: Angular scatter of stars around the arm centre line. Small = thin, pronounced arms.

fields.label: Core size
fields.description: Radius of the central blob as a fraction of the galaxy radius.

fields.label: Core star share
fields.description: Fraction of all stars placed in the central blob.

fields.label: Between-arm star share
fields.description: Fraction of stars scattered between the arms, so the gaps are sparse rather than empty.

fields.label: Edge thinning
fields.description: How quickly star density falls off toward the rim. 0.5 = uniform density, higher = thinner outskirts.
